models.name: GPT Transcribe
models.description: OpenAI's current transcription model and the one it recommends. Most accurate of the set, and cheap per minute.

models.name: GPT-4o Transcribe
models.description: The previous generation, kept for setups that already use it. Good with accents and crosstalk.

models.name: GPT-4o mini Transcribe
models.description: The previous generation's cheaper model, kept for setups that already use it.

models.name: Whisper
models.description: The original endpoint. Widest language coverage, and the only one that returns segment timings.

models.name: Whisper large v3 turbo
models.description: Fastest here by a wide margin, on Groq's hardware. Near large-v3 accuracy.

models.name: Whisper large v3
models.description: The accurate one, for recordings worth a second longer.

models.name: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2
models.description: Mistral's transcription model, among the cheapest per minute. European hosting, which is sometimes the deciding factor.
